title: SPRINGFIELD SYMPHONY: From the New World
seo_title: Springfield Symphony: From the New World in Springfield, MO
description: This Springfield Symphony Orchestra concert centers on Dvorak's New World Symphony, which takes inspiration from African American music. The program also includes Adolphus Hailstork's Three Spirituals for Orchestra, Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto with violinist Fiona Shea, and the orchestra's Hellam Competition Winner. It takes place Saturday, March 6, 2027 at 7:30 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO, with tickets sold only through HammonsHall.com and MissouriStateTix.com.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
